result.description:
Engaged Finance is a growing mortgage brokerage based in Melbourne's inner west. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional advice, outstanding customer service and creating long-term relationships with our clients.

We're looking for a motivated Mortgage Broker who is hungry to grow their career and become a key part of our business.

As a Mortgage Broker at Engaged Finance, you'll work with a steady flow of business-generated leads while also proactively building your own referral network and client relationships. You'll be responsible for managing clients throughout the entire lending journey, from the initial enquiry through to settlement and beyond.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Meeting with clients to understand their financial goals and borrowing needs.
- Recommending suitable lending solutions from our panel of lenders.
- Converting business-generated leads into settled home loans.
- Prospecting and developing relationships with referral partners to generate new business.
- Preparing and submitting loan applications.
- Liaising with lenders, solicitors, conveyancers and other stakeholders.
- Working closely with our loan processing team to ensure a seamless client experience.
- Providing exceptional customer service and ongoing support to clients.
- Maintaining accurate client records and CRM updates.
- Achieving monthly settlement and activity targets.

What We Offer

- Competitive Base Salary + Commission + Superannuation
- Unlimited leads provided by the business
- Vibrant, young and supportive office environment
- Dedicated loan processing support
- Modern office located in Yarraville
- Genuine career growth opportunities

This role is ideal for a motivated broker who enjoys helping clients, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and wants to maximise their earning potential while working within a supportive and energetic team.
